mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary policy, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in boom periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery regimes, a RSAFS increase > 10% MoM signals strengthening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of post-shock recovery instances with RSAFS MoM growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4.5%) signals a tightening monetary cycle, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 58% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200k in a single month signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 62% of instances with PAYEMS increase > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when GDPC1 and RSAFS both exhibit quarterly growth > 1.5%, it signals a demand-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS quarterly growth > 1.5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 18-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in boom periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
